title: Whispers of yesteryear broken on gears of tomorrow's false promise. Turning in fickle hearts dulled notches slipping on realities of stolen prophets #
summary: Whispers of yesteryear broken on gears of tomorrow's false promise. Turning in fickle hearts dulled notches slipping on realities of stolen prophets #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Whispers of yesteryear
broken on gears
of tomorrow's false
promise. Turning
in fickle hearts
dulled notches
slipping on
realities
of stolen prophets
#smallpoems
